description: The Fangblade Skirmisher is a nimble and vicious warrior, often found as part of marauding bands that ambush travelers. With quick reflexes and sharp fangs adorning their blades, they specialize in hit-and-run tactics, striking quickly and retreating before enemies can retaliate.

traits.name: Skirmisher's Agility
traits.description: The Fangblade Skirmisher can move up to half its speed as a bonus action without provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.description: The Fangblade Skirmisher has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Fangblade Skirmisher makes two attacks with its Fangblade.

actions.name: Fangblade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 4 (1d6) poison damage.
